name: Sunbay City Stories: Tina from the Grand Auto Workshop
detailed_description:
Story:

In the sun-soaked tropical city of Sunbay City, Tina, a driven college student spending her summer working as a mechanic at Grand Auto Workshop "Iron Balls", dreams of exploring new horizons and expanding her sensual boundaries — with a little help from Mike, our daring protagonist, in this captivating spin-off story.

Game features:

  • Open world

  • Visual novel-style dialogues with dynamic scenes

  • Drivable car with the ability to pick up NPCs

  • First-person and third-person player view

  • Interactive explicit scenes with pose selection, full 360-degree camera view, POV for male and female

  • Light-hearted and fun storyline with unexpected twists

  • In-game smartphone with useful apps

Official Notice to Players:

Dear players,

Before you purchase or start playing our game, we'd like to highlight a few important things.

This game is an independent project created by a very small team, funded entirely through crowdfunding and the generous support of our community. Our resources and capabilities are limited, and this is our first-ever game. We sincerely appreciate your patience and understanding.

Our game includes elements not typically found in major commercial releases, such as mature content, strong language, and scenes depicting drug use. These elements are intentionally included to provide a more authentic and immersive storytelling experience. We’re being upfront about this so you can make an informed decision before purchasing.

We completely understand that this game may not meet the expectations of players accustomed to big-budget titles from large publishers. This is a short, story-driven game meant to be completed in a few hours. We acknowledge this openly and transparently — our trailers and promotional materials aim to honestly reflect the game, and we do not intend to mislead or disappoint you.

We're committed to improving the game whenever we can, releasing updates and fixes as our resources allow.

Thank you again for your amazing support, your patience, and your constructive feedback. It means the world to us.

Warmest regards,
RWB Team.
